description: List a company's current job postings (title, location, posted/last-seen dates) — a signal for headcount growth in a specific team. BYOK: pass your own Apollo _apiKey. Needs an Apollo `organization_id` (get one from apollo_search_organizations or apollo_enrich_organization first). Apollo cost: 1 Apollo credit per page, up to 10,000 postings total. Example: apollo_org_job_postings({ organization_id: "5e66b6381e05b4008c8331b8", _apiKey: "your-apollo-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your Apollo API key. Get one at https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key.

organization_id.description: Apollo company id, e.g. from an apollo_search_organizations/apollo_enrich_organization result's `id` field.

name: apollo_org_job_postings
title: Apollo Org Job Postings
